about_the_game:
Take command of a mighty airship fortress and wage war across the skies! Build your aerial fleet of zeppelins, gunships, and laser machines to battle fearsome dragons and rival commanders. Harvest resources, supply your front line and master strategic advancements to reclaim the skies!

Airships

The airship fortress is your central control hub to build more airships. You will need resource collectors to make airships, reactors to power your aircraft and fighter airships to defeat and defend from different types of dragons. Move them and strategically place them to fight off waves of enemies!

Dragons

Dragons will come in all shapes and sizes! Average dragons, such as green and orange dragons are similiar in strength and attack in small numbers. Tiny dragons are super weak but come in huge hoards. Then there are the mega dragons who come in groups of 1 or 2 and are super strong. 

Rebels

While reclaiming the skies, several factions of airship rivals took the chance to put up their own airship fortress. They will collect resources, build airships and send them to attack you. Counter with your objectively better aircraft however be careful that they don't outnumber you!

List of Features

  • Multiple Game modes (Endless, Campaign)

  • Dragon Enemy

  • Rebel Enemy

  • Build and control airships

  • Manage resources

  • Destroy enemies with airship control management!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (3.2 GHz) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 2GB or AMD Radeon R7 260x 2GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
